CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFTEXTINPUT

CFTEXTINPUT was a Java applet text box with its own font and colors. KoldFusion renders it as an HTML text field carrying the same styling, with the same validation options as CFINPUT. It must be used inside CFFORM.

Category

Forms

Syntax

<CFTEXTINPUT NAME="name"
    VALUE="text"
    REQUIRED="Yes/No"
    VALIDATE="data_type"
    RANGE="min_value,max_value"
    ONVALIDATE="javascript_function"
    MESSAGE="text"
    ONERROR="javascript_function"
    SIZE="integer"
    MAXLENGTH="integer"
    FONT="font_name"
    FONTSIZE="integer"
    BOLD="Yes/No"
    ITALIC="Yes/No"
    BGCOLOR="color"
    TEXTCOLOR="color"
    HEIGHT="pixels"
    WIDTH="pixels"
    VSPACE="pixels"
    HSPACE="pixels"
    ALIGN="alignment"
    NOTSUPPORTED="text">

Attributes

NAME
Required. Name of the form field.
VALUE
Optional. Initial text.
REQUIRED
Optional, default "No". Yes: the field must not be empty.
VALIDATE
Optional. Data type to check; the same types as CFINPUT (date, eurodate, time, float, integer, telephone, zipcode, creditcard, social_security_number).
RANGE
Optional. Minimum and maximum numeric value, as "min,max".
ONVALIDATE
Optional. Your own JavaScript validation function, as in CFINPUT.
MESSAGE
Optional. Alert text when a check fails.
ONERROR
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion always uses the standard alert.
SIZE
Optional, default "20". Width of the field in characters.
MAXLENGTH
Optional. Maximum number of characters accepted.
FONT
Optional. Font face of the text.
FONTSIZE
Optional. Font size in points.
BOLD
Optional, default "No". Yes shows the text in bold.
ITALIC
Optional, default "No". Yes shows the text in italics.
BGCOLOR
Optional. Background color: a color name or a hex value such as #FFFFCC.
TEXTCOLOR
Optional. Text color.
HEIGHT
Optional. Applet height. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
WIDTH
Optional. Applet width. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it (use SIZE).
VSPACE
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
HSPACE
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
ALIGN
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
NOTSUPPORTED
Optional. Text for browsers without Java. No longer needed; KoldFusion ignores it.

Usage

The styling is written as a STYLE attribute, which browsers from Internet Explorer 4 and Netscape 4 onward understand. Inside CFOUTPUT remember to double the # of hex colors.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFIF IsDefined("Form.Callsign")>
  <CFOUTPUT><P>Welcome aboard, <B>#HTMLEditFormat(Form.Callsign)#</B>
  (#Form.Hours# hours online this week).</CFOUTPUT>
</CFIF>

<CFFORM NAME="Pilot" ACTION="cftextinput.cfm">
<P>Screen name:
<CFTEXTINPUT NAME="Callsign" VALUE="WebSurfer99" SIZE="20" MAXLENGTH="16"
    FONT="Courier New" FONTSIZE="11" BOLD="Yes"
    BGCOLOR="Navy" TEXTCOLOR="Yellow"
    REQUIRED="Yes" MESSAGE="Every pilot needs a screen name.">
<P>Hours online per week:
<CFTEXTINPUT NAME="Hours" VALUE="40" SIZE="4" VALIDATE="integer"
    RANGE="0,168" ITALIC="Yes" MESSAGE="A week has only 168 hours.">
<P><INPUT TYPE="Submit" VALUE="Sign on">
</CFFORM>
